message: pnpm 10.28.0 loads .pnpmfile.cjs and names updateConfig at line 1, and the updateConfig hook of a pnpmfile can change every setting after pnpm has read its configuration files, so depcurfew cannot verify the settings it checks
fix: Read .pnpmfile.cjs and make sure its updateConfig hook leaves minimumReleaseAge, allowBuilds and the other security settings as they are; if the project needs no pnpmfile, remove it and set pnpmfile: [] in pnpm-workspace.yaml, so that pnpm loads no new one by itself
